title: Book Two · Chapter 189: Say It to the Visitor
story:
For the spoken task, Ronan gets a clean copy of the packet. His written answers stay on Miss Wu's desk. He must read and explain the information again.

Miss Wu sits on the visitor's side of the table. Another teacher has the check sheet. She gives no help. These two teachers hear every student's answers.

“I am here for a picture packet,” Miss Wu says. “It is the changed afternoon. Where do I go?”

Ronan looks at the visitor's collection number. Then he points to the garden path on the plan.

“Use this path. The packet desk is in the smaller room. Its door is beside the garden.”

“Can I go through the main reading room?”

“No. That room is closed to older students this afternoon. Use the outside door.”

“But I am younger.”

Ronan stops. The notice allows younger pupils into the main room. But this visitor needs to collect a packet. He must explain the packet entrance.

He looks at the entrance instruction. “For your packet, everyone uses the garden door. That is the collection entrance today.”

He points to the line. Miss Wu follows his finger.

“I also have my sister's book,” she says. “Can I leave it with the packet desk?”

“Return it at the shelf beside the front desk first. The packet desk does not take returns.”

He shows the return shelf on the plan. He turns the page so she can see it too.

Miss Wu asks about next week. Ronan finds the date and explains that the change ends after today. The usual arrangements return next week.

The last question is not on the page.

“Can my sister collect her packet through me?”

Ronan feels an answer rise. It sounds easy. Families carry things for each other all the time.

He looks at the rule page. It gives collection numbers. It does not say he can collect another person's packet.

“The page does not tell me. Please ask the teacher at the front desk before you collect it,” he says.

“You cannot promise?”

“No. I can show you where to ask.”

The other teacher makes a note. Miss Wu ends the task and turns the check sheet over. Neither gives him a result.

Ronan puts the packet back in order. He thanks both teachers and leaves the room.

His hands shake a little when he lifts his water bottle. He holds it with both hands until he can drink.

Leo is across the yard with a ball. Ronan walks toward him.

“Done?” Leo asks.

“Done.”

“Want to throw?”

Ronan puts his bag down. The first throw is poor. Leo has to run three steps. On the second, Ronan's hand is steadier. The ball goes straight between them.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

explain＝解释；outside door＝外门；promise＝承诺；steadier＝更稳的。

## 理解问题

1. “主阅览室允许年幼学生进入”和“领取资料包统一走花园门”分别管什么？Ronan怎样把后者说清？
2. 页面没有回答代领问题时，他怎样给出可执行的下一步？

## 读句子

**The page does not tell me.**

拆开看：The page / does not tell / me.

这一页／没有告诉／我。
